# authwise_guard_deprovisioning (Data Source)

Reads a Guard tenant's deprovisioning sweep: the account it uses (never the secret) and what the last sweep did.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "authwise_guard_deprovisioning" "this" {
  tenant_id = "gt-01"
}

output "last_sweep" {
  value = {
    result  = data.authwise_guard_deprovisioning.this.last_result
    message = data.authwise_guard_deprovisioning.this.last_message
    revoked = data.authwise_guard_deprovisioning.this.last_revoked
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String) The Guard tenant's id (`gt-…`), as awtenant reports it or `authwise_guard_tenants` lists it; the provider's `tenant_id` is not used.

### Read-Only

- `audience` (String)
- `available` (Boolean) False when the guard-control install has no `sweep.sealKeyFile` or runs in local access mode: no account can be set and nothing is swept.
- `client_id` (String)
- `configured` (Boolean) True when an account is stored.
- `last_message` (String) What the last sweep found, or why it warned.
- `last_result` (String) `ok`, or `warning` when the sweep could not read what it needs or refused to revoke. A warning revokes nothing.
- `last_revoked` (List of String) The nodes the last sweep revoked, by resource name.
- `last_sweep_time` (String) When the tenant was last swept, RFC 3339; null before the first sweep.
- `token_url` (String)
